text: せんちょうは　けんの　たつじん　いあいぎりが　とくい！
note: In Japanese, Cut is named after iai, the real sword art of drawing the blade and cutting in one motion. That is why a sword master is said to be good at it, a link the English name loses.
claim: Iai (iaijutsu/iaido) is a Japanese sword art centred on drawing the sword and cutting in a single motion.

check.quote: the smooth, controlled movements of drawing the sword from its scabbard (or saya), striking or cutting an opponent, shaking blood from the blade, and replacing the sword in the scabbard
